summary: 'I don't know' is the KNOW sign (fingertips at the forehead) flipping away from the head, with a head shake. One sign, whole sentence.
movement: Fingertips touch the forehead, then the hand turns palm-out and away
steps: Touch the fingertips of a bent flat hand to the side of your forehead (that's KNOW).
Flip the hand outward so the palm faces away from you.
Shake your head and shrug slightly.
note: The flip-away is a negation built into the sign. KNOW stays at the head; DON'T-KNOW throws it off. Several ASL signs negate this way, including DON'T-LIKE and DON'T-WANT.
mistakes: Leaving the hand at the forehead. That's KNOW, the opposite of what you mean.
